title: Third Time's a Charm, Apparently
text: “Isn’t Panda doing the exact same thing Sadeena-san did?”
“Indeed, she is.”
I recognized it immediately, having just witnessed the same performance moments ago.
“Um, Panda? Are you even listening to me?”
“…Ah, Panda hears you. Loud and clear.”
“So does that mean you’re taking me somewhere useful? Motoyasu-kun and Itsuki are right over there, you know.”
“Yes, yes.”
“Panda? Where exactly are you dragging me off to? Could you at least tell me that much first?”
“Hey! Panda! Are you listening?! Hellooo?!”
And just like that, Father was hauled off yet again.
“Uh, um… I’ll be right back.”
Big Sister, still cradling the Raph-species creature, dashed off after Panda and Father.

“Ehh… how should I put this. Naofumi-san, is it possible that the moment he stops being human, some kind of overwhelming Shield Hero charm just… erupts out of him? I’m getting nervous just imagining what would happen if he ever met Gaelion-san.”
“He will never meet her, I say. I shall protect Father with my very life.”
“You didn’t exactly protect him from Larsazusa-san or Sadeena-san though, did you?”
“Those two ladies are precious people to Father, you see. But Rival is an entirely different matter — the moment it loses its senses, it gets erased. Simple as that.”
Older Sister and Panda were people Father had chosen to grow close to of his own free will. Rival, on the other hand, was utterly out of the question.

After a while, the ground began to bulge and churn, and a hole opened up right in front of Itsuki’s house, where we’d been hiding. Out from it emerged Father, Ren, the Mole, and Big Sister. For some reason, Father and Ren were both decked out in ribbons. It also looked like they’d brought along outfits fashioned to resemble our own clothes.
“Thank you, Raphtalia-chan, Imiya-chan.”
“You’re a lifesaver. I can’t believe even Filoko helped out.”
“Yep,” Filoko chirped.
Father and the others hurried inside the house.
“Naofumi-san, Ren-san, well done making it out alive.”
“That… was rough,” Ren said, letting out a deep sigh.

“I got caught by Luna, held down in a mass of feathers, and thoroughly kneaded all over. Then just as Imiya and the other Roomo folk suggested dressing me up and dragged me off to the costume workshop, I honestly thought I’d been betrayed.”
“S-sorry about that,” the Mole muttered apologetically to Ren.
But wait — if Ren managed to escape, didn’t that mean a hungry Luna-chan was probably scouring the area for him even now?
“I was pretty shocked myself,” Father said. “There I was, being turned into Panda’s personal dress-up doll, when Ren showed up together with Luna-chan. I’d heard he’d been caught, but still.”
“Wait, weren’t you supposed to be caught by Sadeena, Naofumi? Why’d you end up with Larsazusa instead?”

“I managed to slip away from Sadeena-san, but then when I asked Panda for help, she caught me too and dressed me up instead. She kept going, ‘Fufufu… this is payback for turning me into a dress-up doll. Just sit still until we see how it turns out,’ all while breathing strangely heavily.”
“Ahh… I feel like you’ve earned yourself a bit of a grudge there, Naofumi-san.”

“Well… I don’t think ‘payback’ is quite the right word. I think it’s more that I severely underestimated Panda’s personal tastes. She even had her subordinates searching for a way to fix my current state.”
According to Father, apparently Panda had a secret love for cute things.

“So essentially, Luna-san, an open lover of cute things, and Larsazusa-san, a closet lover of cute things, ended up sharing the same goal and jointly turned Naofumi-san and Ren-san into dress-up dolls.”
“That’s about the size of it. Honestly, the second I turned into this form, it’s just been one disaster after another.”
It seemed Father and the others had gone through quite the ordeal. Curses… as Motoyasu, I find it utterly regrettable that fear of Luna-chan’s presence left me frozen in place, unable to act.
“Really though, well done escaping.”
“Yeah, that’s thanks to Raphtalia-chan and Imiya-chan, who brought Raph-chan, Fleon-chan, and Filoko-chan along and worked all sorts of angles.”
“Fleon-chan helped too?”

“Well… Fleon-chan didn’t seem to fully grasp what was going on, but she went and passionately lectured the two of them about outfit coordination, which drew their attention nicely. Filoko-chan covered the sound of Imiya-chan and the others securing an escape route by playing music.”
Apparently Fleon-chan and Filoko-chan had shown their faces to draw Panda and Luna-chan’s attention, buying time for the Mole and Big Sister to help Father and the others make their getaway.

“And then, as the finishing move, Raph-chan used illusion magic to disguise herself as me, and Rafumi-chan — who Ren ordered into service, however reluctantly — swapped in and played the decoy while I made my escape.”
“Honestly… that Rafumi… do I really look that pathetically alone to her?”
Ahaha… Father laughed awkwardly at Ren.
“Ugh, seriously… I heard something was going on, but what exactly happened? Hey!”
Tiger Guy came grumbling across the village square.
“Oh, it’s Fohl-kun. Let’s call him over and get his help.”
“Naofumi-san!”
Father took off running again and called out to Tiger Guy.
“Th-this is—”
“Fohl-kun, you came running because you heard the commotion, huh? I know I’ve ended up looking like this, but it’s me, Naofumi… Fohl-kun? Are you listening to me?”
Tiger Guy glanced rapidly around the surroundings, then scooped Father up and took off sprinting.
“Third time’s a charmmmmm—!!”
“Naofumi-san, there is such a thing as being too careless, you know!!!”
“Father, please waaaait, I say!!!”
“Shh! Quiet down! You’ll bring Luna running!”
“Eeeeeek……”
While I cowered in fear, Father got carried off by Tiger Guy.
“Uh, um…”
“W-we’ll go after them,” said Big Sister.
Big Sister and the Mole took off chasing after Tiger Guy. After a while, Father came back, carried this time by Tiger Girl, accompanied by Big Sister and the Mole. What an unusual combination.
“Atla-chan, thank you.”
“It was nothing at all,” Tiger Girl said.
“Naofumi-san, honestly, what kind of man are you… are you satisfied getting rescued by little girls over and over?”
“Well… I figured since Fohl-kun’s a guy, it’d be fine…”
“My big brother came rushing in shouting, ‘I found a fascinating creature!’ carrying Naofumi-sama along with him, so once I heard the situation, I came to bring him back.”
“You really saved me. Thank you too, Raphtalia-chan, Imiya-chan.”
Just then, the Mole scooped Father up without warning.
“Hm? What’s wrong?”
“Um…”
“It’s nothing.”
The Mole seemed to snap back to her senses and set Father back down, though she kept shaking her head over and over.

“Naofumi-san, I think what’s happening is that your power as the Shield Hero is running a bit wild now that you’re not in human form. It seems like demi-humans and beastfolk get caught up in some strange sensation whenever they look at you.”
“Eh? Is that really it?”
“…Yes. It’s like… there’s this vague urge to protect you…”
“Y-yes… actually…”
Big Sister and the Mole nodded together. Ahh, so that’s why they’d been avoiding looking directly at him.
“We’ll be keeping watch outside, so let us know if anything happens.”
“Alright.”
With that, the Mole and Big Sister stepped out.
“Naofumi-san, please act with a bit more caution from now on. Being this careless is exactly why you keep getting caught in traps.”
“My apologies… I wonder if this is some kind of correction effect from the Shield being a Legendary Weapon…”
“Who knows. At this rate, it feels like the demi-humans and beastfolk are about to start a bloody turf war over you, Hero.”
“Ugh, that sounds awful… I wonder if something like this happened back in Siltvelt too, with everyone fighting over the Shield Hero.”
“I’d say it was less about the Hero and more about the Princess, honestly.”
“Is that really any better?”
“In any case… since he’s an ally, we can’t exactly attack him outright, which makes this rather troublesome.”
“Right, that’s the thing… I figure if I unleash something like Meteor Shield or one of those skills, I could probably create an opening, but, well… you know.”
Ren nodded along at Father’s words. Meanwhile, Itsuki and Ren tilted their heads slightly.
“Fohl-san went down for the count… but then why didn’t it work on Atla-san?”
